title: Tank base
concept: The steel plinth a containment tank's glass stands in.
sheet: Studio product photograph of a single round heavy steel base plinth for a laboratory tank, on its own and empty: low and wide, a bolted flange round its flat top with an empty shallow round socket in the middle, nothing standing in it, no glass, short pipes with valves and a pressure gauge on its side, cable conduits, worn dark grey steel with scuffs and rust, seen from front three-quarter above. A single object alone, whole object in frame with generous space around it, plain light grey seamless background, soft even studio light, no floor, no shadows, no text or logos.
notes: Budget: 2,000 triangles, 1K maps. Under the glass; the vat and the tank scale it.
